words.sense: Formally put in place for now but expected to change once more information becomes available; arranged but not yet final.
misconceptions: thinking it means hesitant or unsure of oneself

words.sense: Uncertain or hesitant rather than formally temporary.
misconceptions: thinking it means officially arranged or temporary

semantic_axes.description: Whether something is a formal arrangement (provisional) or an attitude/feeling (tentative).
Whether the uncertainty comes from a lack of information (provisional) or lack of personal commitment (tentative).
Whether the quality is in the external setup (provisional) or internal state (tentative).

provisional: The board signed a provisional agreement until the legal review is complete.
We have a provisional timetable for the construction of the new laboratory.
The government formed a provisional administration to stabilize the country.
She was granted a provisional license to drive while her application was processed.
This is just a provisional budget; we will finalize it in September.
They made a provisional arrangement for the conference to be held next month.
tentative: He took a tentative step onto the ice, afraid it might crack.
She offered a tentative smile, unsure how they would react to the news.
Our plan for the weekend is still tentative until we hear back from Sam.
He made a tentative approach to the group, not wanting to intrude.
There was a tentative agreement to meet again, but no one was truly committed.
They held a tentative conversation about the possibility of working together.

provisional: He took a provisional step onto the ice.
Our plan for the weekend is still provisional.
He made a provisional approach to the group.

tentative: The board signed a tentative agreement until the legal review is complete.
We have a tentative timetable for the construction of the new laboratory.

This is just a tentative budget.

edges.boundary_rule: Use provisional for things (agreements, plans) that are officially set up but not finalized. Use tentative for actions or attitudes that are hesitant or lack confidence.

misconceptions.M2: Tentative implies a planned interim step.
misconceptions.M3: Any plan that might change is provisional.

beats.text: The university senate officially adopted a set of revised weekend library hours, decreeing that the schedule will take effect immediately while student attendance data is collected across the semester.
beats.decisive_clue: officially adopted a set of revised weekend library hours, decreeing that the schedule will take effect immediately while student attendance data is collected

chains.feedback_short: An officially enacted schedule operating until permanent rules are passed is provisional.
chains.feedback_deep: Provisional applies to formal arrangements, administrative measures, or policies that are officially put in place for now but subject to future confirmation. It does not reflect emotional hesitation.
chains.contrast_rule: Formal interim measures are provisional; hesitant or uncommitted decisions are tentative.
